The '''Saki system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the ''[[Bootana Hutta/Legends|Bootana Hutta]]'' region of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sakiya]].

==History==
The [[Sakiyan/Legends|Sakiyans]] had very little interest in anything beyond their own [[Star system/Legends|star system]] and rarely ventured far from their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Sakiya]].<ref name="LoNH" /> They also showed little interest in traveling or trading with [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] at large.<ref name="UAA">''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]''</ref>

Thanks to its location on the edge of the ''[[Bootana Hutta/Legends|Bootana Hutta]]'', deep within [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]],<ref name="LoNH" /> the Saki system escaped the tyranny of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], although many Sakiyan [[Technician/Legends|technicians]] were forced to relocate to Imperial research centers where they contributed to the development of a new generation of Imperial [[Hovertank/Legends|repulsortanks]].<ref name="UAA" />

The Saki system also escaped the notice of the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] as they [[Yuuzhan Vong War|pressed]] into Hutt Space.<ref name="UAA" />
